title: Первое маленькое открытие

beats.action: Mia takes out the small discovery notebook while remaining on the path.
She draws a simple spiral and a short trail instead of collecting anything.
Stepa points to the drawing and nods; the snail remains in the background.
Mia closes the notebook and both children look back at the snail.

safety_gates: Use drawings rather than collecting a wild specimen.
Keep notebook and clothing consistent in later shots.
Dialogue timing remains estimated until voiceover; no phoneme alignment.
